---
title: desugar
---

The structural desugaring contract (bd-7gqr148v, GH #846): what the qmd
reader turns into a `Table`, `DefinitionList` or `Figure` must come out
the same when an lmd cell builds the shape from nodes, writes it inside
a fragment, or reads it back from JSON.

## 1. Literal list-table (control)

::: {.list-table}
* - Key
  - Value
* - `a`
  - one
:::

## 2. list-table div built from AST nodes in a cell

```{lmd}
local function row(cells)
  local items = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(cells) do table.insert(items, { pandoc.Plain(c) }) end
  return { pandoc.BulletList(items) }
end
local rows = {
  row({ {pandoc.Str("Key")}, {pandoc.Str("Value")} }),
  row({ {pandoc.Code("b")}, {pandoc.Str("two")} }),
}
return pandoc.Div({ pandoc.BulletList(rows) }, pandoc.Attr("", {"list-table"}))
```

## 3. Literal definition-list (control)

::: {.definition-list}
* Term
  * A definition.
:::

## 4. definition-list div built from AST nodes in a cell

```{lmd}
local item = {
  pandoc.Plain({ pandoc.Str("Term") }),
  pandoc.BulletList({ { pandoc.Plain({ pandoc.Str("A definition.") }) } }),
}
return pandoc.Div({ pandoc.BulletList({ item }) }, pandoc.Attr("", {"definition-list"}))
```

## 5. list-table inside a fragment

```{lmd}
return {=:
::: {.list-table}
* - Key
  - Value
* - `c`
  - three
:::
:=}
```

## 6. Pipe table inside a fragment

```{lmd}
return {=:
| Key | Value |
|-----|------:|
| `d` | four  |
:=}
```

## 7. definition-list inside a fragment

```{lmd}
return {=:
::: {.definition-list}
* Term
  * A definition.
:::
:=}
```

## 8. Single-image paragraph built from nodes

```{lmd}
return pandoc.Para({ pandoc.Image({ pandoc.Str("A pixel") }, "pixel.png", "", pandoc.Attr("fig-pixel")) })
```

## 9. Invalid list-table built from nodes (no rows list)

```{lmd}
return pandoc.Div({ pandoc.Para({ pandoc.Str("not a list") }) }, pandoc.Attr("", {"list-table"}))
```

## 10. pandoc.read of list-table markdown

```{lmd}
return pandoc.read("::: {.list-table}\n* - Key\n  - Value\n* - `e`\n  - five\n:::\n", "markdown").blocks
```

## 11. pandoc.read of JSON holding a list-table div

```{lmd}
local function cell(s) return { pandoc.Plain({ pandoc.Str(s) }) } end
local rows = pandoc.BulletList({
  { pandoc.BulletList({ cell("Key"), cell("Value") }) },
  { pandoc.BulletList({ cell("f"), cell("six") }) },
})
local doc = pandoc.Pandoc({ pandoc.Div({ rows }, pandoc.Attr("", {"list-table"})) })
return pandoc.read(pandoc.write(doc, "json"), "json").blocks
```

## 12. Inline cell whose footnote holds a list-table div

A note`{lmd} pandoc.Note({ pandoc.Div({ pandoc.BulletList({ { pandoc.BulletList({ { pandoc.Plain({ pandoc.Str("g") }) }, { pandoc.Plain({ pandoc.Str("seven") }) } }) } }) }, pandoc.Attr("", {"list-table"})) })` here.
